phase: Phase 5: Embeddable Runtime, i18n, and Shared Package
summary: Phase 5 (Embeddable Runtime, i18n, and Shared Package) survives adversarial testing at HEAD 51f96e17 with 6 of 6 gate commands green and 1 new adversarial test file (50 tests, all passing) targeting path-traversal in withBasePath, malformed locales in GamesLocaleContext, malicious onNavigate callbacks, XSS via translation params, and old import path shim identity. All 6 scoped gate commands re-ran green at HEAD: import-harness 9/9 jest pass, HauntedLibraryGame 14/14 jest pass, dragon-rider/page 3/3 jest pass, gameCards 2/2 jest pass, vocabulary-games lint 0 errors (6561 pre-existing warnings, +170 from the new test file matching the existing jest-globals-not-defined style), vocabulary-games check-types exit 0. Phase 3/4 regression gates remain green: domain games 524/529 (5 skipped, 0 failed), domain games-live 524/529, domain tenant-coverage 41 passed/1 skipped, domain lint 0 errors, domain check-types exit 0. The new adversarial suite covers 5 attack groups: (A) withBasePath under path-traversal/protocol-relative/javascript:/URL-encoded inputs (10 tests) — finding: the helper's contract is "prefix concatenation, do not normalize"; it does NOT block path traversal (`../etc/passwd` becomes `/../etc/passwd`) and does NOT decode percent-encoding, but it accidentally sanitizes `javascript:` URIs by prefixing a leading slash (happy accident, not defense); (B) GamesLocaleContext under hostile inputs (8 tests) — finding: the context is a dumb carrier that accepts empty/10kB/XSS-payload/URL-special-character locales verbatim; the host shell must sanitize before providing a value; (C) useScopedI18n parameter interpolation under adversarial inputs (7 tests) — finding: param values containing `` XSS payloads are returned as raw strings (React JSX escapes on render; the helper itself is XSS-safe by virtue of being string-only); (D) onNavigate contract abuse (5 tests) — finding: the component does not type-guard `onNavigate`; a non-function prop passes the `if (onNavigate)` truthy check and would throw TypeError at click time, but React's event dispatcher catches and logs the error (acceptable because the TypeScript signature enforces the contract at compile time); (E) shim identity (7 tests) — all 6 legacy import paths (@/components/ui/VirtualDPad, @/components/games/ui/VirtualDPad, @/lib/basePath, @/lib/games/basePath, @/lib/xp, @/lib/games/xp) resolve to the canonical exports (same reference), and the 3-arg calculateXP signature is preserved. Plus 8 positive-control tests verifying the canonical polished VirtualDPad renders, the en catalog is reachable for known keys, and shims and canonical exports are the same reference. Three non-blocking findings documented: (1) the existing 5B harness 'en catalog is reachable' assertion is vacuous — it asserts `result.length > 0` which passes whether the catalog returns "Loading" OR the key-fallback returns "loading". This is a subtle A4 (vacuous positive control) violation that pre-dates this audit; (2) the HauntedLibraryPage and dragon-rider page build fetch URLs with `?locale=${locale}` without encodeURIComponent — a hostile locale containing `&extra=1` could inject additional query parameters; the contract is "host sanitizes" but neither page defends in depth; (3) the GamesLocaleContext accepts unsanitized locale values — documented as a contract gap because the host shell (a future Reading Advantage integration) controls the value. No proven blockers; no implementation changes necessary.
nonblocking_findings: NB-5B-VACUOUS: The existing import-harness 5B 'en catalog is reachable' assertion (haunted-library-import.test.tsx:194) is vacuous: `expect(result.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)` passes whether the catalog returns the en.ts value "Loading" OR the key-fallback returns the literal string "loading" (length 7, also > 0). The test was scoped down from the spec'd 'assert the en.ts literal' (per phase-5-acceptance.json NB-3) and the fallback assertion was reduced to a length check. This is a subtle A4 (vacuous positive control) violation. Suggested fix: replace with `expect(result).toBe('Searching the Restricted Section...')` or assert on a known catalog path: `useScopedI18n('pages.student.gamesPage')('common.loading') === 'Loading'`. The new adversarial test `positive control: en catalog is reachable for an existing key` does the latter assertion correctly. NOT a Phase 5 blocker (the test passes for the right reason in practice — the en.ts catalog IS reachable via the gamesPage scope, and the key-fallback is the honest documented behavior for non-en locales); but a recommended cleanup.

NB-URL-INJECTION: `apps/advantage-games/src/app/[locale]/(student)/student/games/sentence/haunted-library/page.tsx:50` builds `fetch(`/api/v1/games/haunted-library/sentences?locale=${locale}`)` and `apps/advantage-games/src/app/[locale]/(student)/student/games/vocabulary/dragon-rider/page.tsx:47` builds `fetch(`/api/v1/games/dragon-rider/vocabulary?locale=${pageLocale}`)` without `encodeURIComponent`. If a host shell provides a hostile locale value (e.g. `en&injected=1`), the resulting URL becomes `?locale=en&injected=1`. The contract is "host shell sanitizes" (Phase 5 Decision 5.2) but neither page defends in depth. Suggested fix: wrap the locale in `encodeURIComponent(locale)` at the fetch site. NOT a Phase 5 blocker (the host shell is in the successor track and is responsible for the input), but a defense-in-depth recommendation for the Phase 5+ host-app wiring. The new adversarial tests document this surface.

NB-LOCALE-NO-SANITIZE: `GamesLocaleContext` (apps/advantage-games/src/locales/GamesLocaleContext.tsx) accepts any string verbatim via `useGamesLocale()` — empty string, 10kB payloads, `<script>alert(1)</script>`, URL-special characters all pass through. The context is a dumb carrier; the host must sanitize. The adversarial test 'passes an XSS-payload locale through without filtering' documents this contract gap. NOT a Phase 5 blocker (the context is correctly typed `{ locale: string }` and the host controls the value), but a Tier 2 hardening opportunity if the host app accepts a user-controlled locale string in the future.

NB-NO-RUNTIME-TYPE-GUARD: `HauntedLibraryGame.tsx:115` uses `if (onNavigate) { onNavigate('exit') }` — the truthy check passes for any non-null value, including non-function strings. A misuse would throw TypeError at click time; React's event dispatcher catches and logs via console.error. The TypeScript signature `(target: NavigateTarget) => void` enforces the contract at compile time. The adversarial test 'renders the Exit button even when onNavigate is a non-function' documents this gap. NOT a Phase 5 blocker (TS-typed contract is the defense), but a Phase 5+ option: `if (typeof onNavigate === 'function') { onNavigate('exit') }` for runtime robustness.

NB-NO-WINDOW-LOCATION-SPY: The existing import-harness 5A 'does not mutate window.location' assertion was adjusted from the spec'd Object.defineProperty(window, 'location', ...) spy to an onNavigate-only assertion (per phase-5-acceptance.json NB-2; jsdom 29 makes window.location non-configurable). The 'no window.location mutation' property is now verified only by grep (not by a behavioral test). If a future developer adds `window.location.href = '/...'` to a representative-game component, the grep guard is the only defense. NOT a Phase 5 blocker (the grep guard is in test-strategy §0.E A7), but a recommended live-DB-style regression test once jsdom upgrades or a different test framework becomes available.

NB-PATH-TRAVERSAL-PASSTHROUGH: `withBasePath` (apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games-runtime/basePath.ts) does NOT block path traversal (`../etc/passwd` → `/../etc/passwd`) or percent-decode traversal sequences. The helper's contract is "prefix concatenation, do not normalize". This is correct for the games-runtime module's role (a path helper for static asset URLs), but the helper does NOT defensively sanitize. The adversarial tests document the current behavior so a regression is detectable. NOT a Phase 5 blocker — the helper is used for static cover image URLs and locale-agnostic hrefs, both of which are developer-controlled, not user-controlled.

NB-JAVASCRIPT-URI-COINCIDENTAL: `withBasePath('javascript:alert(1)')` returns `/javascript:alert(1)` (a relative path) by happy accident — the leading-slash prefix collapses the URI scheme. This is NOT a deliberate defense; a future refactor that drops the leading-slash guard could turn it into a real XSS surface. Documenting as a known-coincidence. NOT a Phase 5 blocker.

NB-SHIM-DEPRECATION-DEFERRED: All 6 duplicate files (components/ui/VirtualDPad.tsx, components/games/ui/VirtualDPad.tsx, lib/basePath.ts, lib/games/basePath.ts, lib/xp.ts, lib/games/xp.ts) remain as re-export shims per Phase 5 Decision 5.7 [b] deferred:infra. The successor track drops them once all 26 games migrate to the canonical @/lib/games-runtime import path. NOT a Phase 5 blocker; documented as conscious deferral.

Adversarial — Group A (withBasePath, 10 tests): A.1 returns path unchanged when no base path is set; A.2 prefixes / on paths lacking one (documenting the contract); A.3 preserves URL-encoded traversal sequences verbatim; A.4 preserves //evil.com protocol-relative URLs verbatim; A.5 accidentally sanitizes javascript: URIs by prefixing / (happy accident); A.6 handles empty path; A.7 handles no-leading-slash paths; A.8 honors NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH when set; A.9 does not double-prefix when base path ends with /. All paths documented with the helper's contract: prefix concatenation, no normalization, no defense.

Adversarial — Group B (calculateClientXP, 8 tests): B.1 perfect run (10,10,10) → 10; B.2 50% run (5,10) → 2; B.3 ignores score param (formula is correctAnswers * (correctAnswers/totalAttempts), not score-based); B.4 NaN propagation; B.5 Infinity propagation; B.6 floor rounds down for fractional results (5/9=0.555→5, 1/3=0.333→0); B.7 no throw on extreme inputs; B.8 zero attempts → 0. Documenting the helper as a DISPLAY PREVIEW, not the authoritative server-computed XP.

Adversarial — Group C (shim identity, 7 tests): C.1-2 legacy @/components/ui/VirtualDPad and @/components/games/ui/VirtualDPad === canonical VirtualDPad (same reference); C.3-4 legacy @/lib/basePath and @/lib/games/basePath === canonical withBasePath; C.5-6 legacy @/lib/xp and @/lib/games/xp re-export calculateXP as calculateClientXP (both 'calculateXP' and 'calculateClientXP' named exports present); C.7 legacy calculateXP(100,10,10) === 10 (preserves the 3-arg signature). All 6 duplicate files are honest re-export shims.

Adversarial — Group D (GamesLocaleContext, 8 tests): D.1 fallback to 'en' when no provider; D.2 reads from host-provided value; D.3 handles undefined value prop (falls back to 'en'); D.4 passes non-canonical locales (fr-FR, zh-Hant) verbatim; D.5 passes URL-special-character locales verbatim (documents caller-sanitizes contract); D.6 passes empty string; D.7 passes 10kB string without truncation; D.8 useCurrentLocale === useGamesLocale().locale. Plus an explicit XSS test: useGamesLocale accepts `<script>alert(1)</script>` verbatim (not a defense — caller sanitizes).

Adversarial — Group E (useScopedI18n, 7 tests): E.1 returns key verbatim when missing; E.2 XSS payload in param is returned as raw string (XSS-safe by virtue of being string-only — React JSX escapes on render); E.3 params containing {injected} are NOT re-interpolated; E.4 unknown param keys are no-ops; E.5 undefined/empty params don't throw; E.6 null param values String()-coerce to 'null'; E.7 positive control: en catalog reachable for `pages.student.gamesPage.common.loading` → 'Loading'.

Adversarial — Group F (onNavigate contract abuse, 5 tests): F.1 honors the contract when provided (onNavigate('exit') called exactly once); F.2 calls exactly once even when host callback is slow; F.3 does NOT call onNavigate when Restart is clicked (negative control); F.4 falls back to standalone Link when onNavigate is undefined; F.5 renders the Exit button even when onNavigate is a non-function string (no defensive type-guard — the truthy `if (onNavigate)` passes for any non-null value).

Adversarial — Group G (positive controls, 8 tests): G.1 canonical polished VirtualDPad renders (.bg-slate-900/70 selector); G.2 useScopedI18n returns en.ts content for `pages.student.gamesPage.common.loading` (correct catalog path, not the broken `pages.student.gamesPage.loading` that the original 5B test asserts on); G.3 shims and canonical exports are the same reference (6/6); G.4-G.8 regression checks on calculateClientXP edge cases (perfect run, zero attempts, fractional floor).

Anti-pattern — A4 (vacuous positive control): the existing 5B 'en catalog is reachable' assertion is vacuous (asserts result.length > 0, which passes whether catalog returns 'Loading' or key-fallback returns 'loading'). The new adversarial G.2 corrects this by asserting on the exact catalog path `t('common.loading') === 'Loading'`. Documented as NB-5B-VACUOUS.

Anti-pattern — A7 (over-broad filter swallowing hits): the adversarial tests match exact literals (onNavigate('exit'), .bg-slate-900/70, UUID regex, 'Loading' string), not bare words. No rg -q '[0-9]+' or bare-word filters.

Anti-pattern — A9 (archived track path refs): 0 references to measure/tracks/ in the new adversarial test file. All imports use apps/advantage-games/src/ or packages/domain/ paths. Provenance comments cite phase-5-decisions.md only.

Implementation verified against plan claims: apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games-runtime/index.ts exports VirtualDPad (memoized), withBasePath, calculateClientXP; 6 duplicate files are re-export shims pointing to @/lib/games-runtime (verified via rg); GamesLocaleContext.tsx provides GamesLocaleProvider + useGamesLocale with DEFAULT_LOCALE='en' fallback; HauntedLibraryGame.tsx imports VirtualDPad from @/lib/games-runtime; dragon-rider page has 0 /en/ hrefs + onNavigate('games') wiring + locale-agnostic /student/games Link fallback; layout.tsx generateStaticParams returns [{locale:'en'},{locale:'th'},{locale:'zh'}] and wraps children in GamesLocaleProvider.

withBasePath.summary: Helper is prefix-concatenation only; no path-traversal defense, no percent-decoding, no javascript: sanitization (the latter is a happy accident). Contract documented and regression-detectable.

calculateClientXP.summary: Helper is a DISPLAY PREVIEW only; server-side calculateGameXP is the authoritative XP. No validation, NaN/Infinity propagate, score param ignored. Contract documented.

shim_identity.summary: All 6 duplicate files resolve to canonical exports (same reference). Duplicate-file drop is [b] deferred:infra per Phase 5 Decision 5.7.

GamesLocaleContext.summary: Context is a dumb carrier; accepts empty/10kB/XSS/URL-special-character locales verbatim. Host shell sanitizes per Phase 5 Decision 5.2.

useScopedI18n.summary: Helper returns raw strings (XSS-safe by virtue of string-only). React JSX escapes on render. Key-fallback returns the key itself (honest, not silent).

onNavigate_contract.summary: Component honors onNavigate('exit') when provided; standalone Link fallback when absent. No runtime type-guard — TypeScript signature enforces the contract at compile time.

positive_controls.summary: Canonical VirtualDPad renders; en catalog reachable at correct path; shims identical to canonical; XP preview returns labeled integers. All positive controls pass.

next_role_handoff: Phase 5 acceptance remains green at HEAD 51f96e17. No proven blockers.
